title: Contextual metric normalizer and prefetcher for inference KPIs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight inference-metrics prefetcher and normalization layer that attaches tracing hooks, synthesizes per-request KPIs, and emits OTLP metrics compatible with our Prometheus ingestion flow. The component will run as an optional sidecar on Dedicated nodes and as a slim inline library for hosted paths. Goals: (1) produce stable, low-cardinality labels for model/version/serving-mode; (2) emit request-level histograms/exemplars for latency attribution; (3) surface cache/batch-level signals (KV cache hits, batch size distribution) as normalized metrics; (4) add a configurable prefetch stage to compute token/sequence derived metrics before expensive downstream enrichment so downstream collectors have consistent inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar binary + inline library built and published to internal package registry
Exports metrics in OTLP metric proto v2 and validates against telemetry schema v3
Prometheus-compatible remote-write adapter receives the metrics without cardinality explosion (no unexpected >100x label growth in tenant tests)
Grafana dashboard (telemetry:Inference Prefetcher) shows token_count, kv_cache_hit_rate, per_request_latency_histogram with exemplars linked to traces
End-to-end performance overhead on Dedicated nodes < 2% p50 latency at production QPS in load test
Canary rollout plan documented and exercised (10% traffic, rollback criteria defined)
Backfill adapter included to re-run normalization on historical raw metrics for a 30‑day window
PRs reviewed and merged, automated e2e tests and load tests passing in CI
notes: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Observability, SRE, Runtime teams — scoped sidecar vs inline trade-offs. Action: Diego to prototype sidecar first for Dedicated nodes, inline shim later for hosted API.
2026-03-04: Design decision — canonicalize model labels to stable_model_id and model_role to avoid high cardinality from variant tags. See design doc.
2026-03-06: Chose OTLP metric proto v2 for best compatibility with Prometheus remote-write; will emit exemplars with trace IDs for latency buckets.
2026-03-07: Implementation started — initial prefetch pipeline computes token counts, prompt/response lengths, KV cache lookup sampler, batch metrics aggregator.
2026-03-09: Prototype load test shows 1.6% overhead at 20k rps with 8 GPU pool; KV cache sampler currently adds 0.3% CPU, plan to move to sampling tier for high-throughput tenants.
2026-03-10: Security review checklist completed for data sent in exemplars (trace IDs only, no prompt content). SRE requested retention controls in config.
2026-03-11: PR created for sidecar: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/284 — needs integration tests and perf benchmarks before merge.
2026-03-12: UX review with PM — dashboard wireframe approved; added an acceptance criterion for backfill adapter and canary plan.
environment: Dedicated GPU pools (sidecar) + hosted lightweight shim
qa_plan: Create synthetic tenants that exercise high-cardinality model variant tags; run CI integration with OTLP->remote-write->prometheus test cluster; validate Grafana panels and exemplar-to-trace linkage; run 72-hour canary after merge with traffic shaping and rollback automation.
